title: Determination CI/45/1/238: multi-foil insulation in a loft-conversion roof (Requirement L1(a)(i))
jurisdiction: England (UK): Secretary of State determination / appeal / tribunal under the Building Act 1984 and Building Regulations; comparative test only, not Alberta
code_edition: Building Regulations 2000 (as amended): Requirement L1(a)(i), Part L (conservation of fuel and power)

facts.text: The building is described as a two-bedroom late 1950s bungalow; the insulation is proposed in the roof construction forming part of a loft conversion.
Regulation 4(1)(a) requires building work to be carried out so that it complies with the applicable Schedule 1 requirements; the requirement in question is Requirement L1(a)(i).
The determination records the guidance U-value for this roof construction as no greater than 0.20 W/m2K.
The Secretary of State concludes that the proposed use of multi-foil insulation will not achieve a U-value of 0.20 W/m2K.
The determination records that compliance with Approved Document guidance is not definitive under section 7(1) of the Building Act 1984.
Determination: the plans relating to the use of multi-foil insulation in the proposed roof are not in conformity with Requirement L1(a)(i).
